high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Hindu Business Line," as indicated by the logo at the top. The content of the article discusses the constitutional position regarding water management in India, highlighting that it is inspired by the pre-Independence era, specifically the Government of India Act, 1935. The text in the image criticizes the constitutional framework for being outdated and not aligned with modern concepts related to water resources.
